protocol.added_cuda_synchronizations: outer request boundaries only; original runtime waits retained
protocol.stage_times: inclusive and direct-child-exclusive host/stream elapsed; never sum inclusive nested stages
protocol.prompt: pick up the black bowl between the plate and the ramekin and place it on the plate

model_revision_metadata.action_transform: official saved postprocessor; no additional gripper inversion

checkpoint_provenance.note: load_vlm_weights=False restores full VLM from policy weights; VLM config/tokenizer assets retained separately

metadata.parameter_count_semantics: all registered runtime parameters, including inference-unused heads and tied/derived representation effects
metadata.host_stage_semantics: host elapsed includes launches and implicit waits; exclusive host is an accounting partition, not GPU compute attribution
metadata.saved_postprocessing_semantics: native saved processor may include CPU device transfer and wait for prior GPU work; inspect processor snapshots
metadata.runtime_residual_semantics: unwrapped raw conversion, synchronization, final casts/NumPy views/validation, and wrapper overhead; not pure D2H time

precision_probe.coverage_limit: output dtype and ambient autocast; not a claim about all kernel accumulation precision

accounting.cuda_semantics: elapsed interval on one CUDA stream, including launch/idle gaps; not kernel busy time
accounting.exclusive_subtraction: immediate nonoverlapping children only; wrapper overhead remains in parent
